extracted.intended_audience: Attorneys and agents practicing before the USPTO; petitioners seeking reinstatement after suspension
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office following suspension, based on compliance with a Final Order and supporting sworn statements. The Office reviews the petition, supporting statement, declaration, and the record to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Tara K. Laux received on June 22, 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petitioner must file a Petition for Reinstatement with the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the petition's receipt and timeliness are part of the record considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with the Final Order
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to the terms of the Final Order, Ms. Laux need not comply with 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58 and 11.60, except as set forth in the Final Order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement evaluation examines whether the petitioner has complied with the terms and any specific requirements or exceptions articulated in the Final Order governing the suspension and conditions for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement attesting to compliance with relevant provisions of the Final Order
rubrics_metrics.description: Ms. Laux filed a Petition containing a statement that attests to her compliance with the relevant provisions of the Final Order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition should include an explicit statement by the petitioner attesting that they have complied with the applicable provisions of the Final Order; such a statement is considered in deciding reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sworn declaration of non-practice during suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: A sworn declaration that she has not engaged in the practice of trademark or other non-patent law before the Office during the period of suspension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petitioners must provide a sworn statement (declaration) affirming they have not engaged in prohibited practice before the Office during suspension; this is a specific factual element weighed by the Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of supporting materials and the record material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting statement and declaration, and all information in the record material to her eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director's decision is based on a comprehensive review of the petition, supporting documents, sworn declarations, and any other record information pertinent to eligibility; satisfying these evidentiary and factual matters supports a grant of reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ultimately, reinstatement is granted when the Director, after review, determines the petitioner has met the requirements and conditions set forth in the Final Order and the record supports eligibility.
